## Claims
- [proved] For \(\rho=\varnothing,(1),(2),(1,1),(3),(2,1),(3,1),(2,2),(3,2)\), the required integral identities follow from the Pieri expansions listed in Strategy.
- [unsupported] The remaining \(\rho=(3,3)\) identity has not been derived here; hence the requested all-\(\rho\) certificate is not established.

## Strategy
Write \(L_\rho=\bar s_{(3^3,\rho)}\) and \(R_{\rho'}=\bar s_{(3+\rho'_1,3+\rho'_2,3+\rho'_3)}\). The following exact identities hold in \(\Lambda/I_{5,5}\), with every Schur factor on the right in \(J\):
\[
\begin{aligned}
R_\varnothing-L_\varnothing&=0,\\
R_{(1)}+L_{(1)}&=h_1\bar s_{333},\\
R_{(11)}-L_{(2)}&=h_1\bar s_{433}-h_2\bar s_{333},\\
R_{(2)}-L_{(11)}&=h_2\bar s_{333}-h_1\bar s_{3331},\\
R_{(111)}+L_{(3)}
&=h_1\bar s_{443}-h_2\bar s_{433}
+h_2\bar s_{3331}-h_1\bar s_{33311},\\
R_{(21)}+L_{(21)}
&=h_1\bar s_{533}+h_1\bar s_{3332}-h_3\bar s_{333},\\
R_{(211)}-L_{(31)}
&=h_1(\bar s_{5331}+\bar s_{444}-\bar s_{4431}
+\bar s_{4332}+\bar s_{43311}+\bar s_{3333})
-2h_3\bar s_{3331},\\
R_{(22)}-L_{(22)}
&\text{ is not independently certified here},\\
R_{(221)}+L_{(32)}
&=h_1\bar s_{553}-h_3\bar s_{533}+h_4\bar s_{433}
-h_1\bar s_{4333}+h_2\bar s_{3333}-h_5\bar s_{333}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Here the subscript on \(R\) is \(\rho'\); e.g. \(R_{(11)}=\bar s_{443}\), \(R_{(2)}=\bar s_{533}\), \(R_{(211)}=\bar s_{544}\), and \(R_{(221)}=\bar s_{554}\).

Each displayed equality is checked by the horizontal-strip Pieri rule; for example
\[
h_2\bar s_{333}=\bar s_{533}+\bar s_{4331}+\bar s_{3332},\qquad
h_1\bar s_{3331}=\bar s_{4331}+\bar s_{3332}+\bar s_{33311}.
\]

## Gaps
The identities for \(\rho=(2,2)\) and \((3,3)\) are missing. Therefore the demanded certificate for every \(\rho\subseteq3^2\) is not established.
